page.title: Meta
page.subtitle: Live competitive data from Limitless TCG

window.onlineBo1Hint: Only online tournaments played Bo1 Swiss (ground-truth from Limitless: isOnline + Swiss mode) — the best proxy for local Bo1 Challenges & Cups. Turn off to include every recorded tournament (online + in-person, mixed format).
window.noData: No data yet — run "Sync Live Meta".
window.scopeOnline: Based on online Bo1 tournaments only, ground-truth classified (isOnline + Swiss mode) — Bo1 Swiss like local Challenges/Cups. Structurally grounded, not empirically proven.
window.scopeAll: Based on all recorded tournaments (online + in-person, mixed Bo1/Bo3 format).

prediction.title: Prediction — your local meta
prediction.intro: Build the field you expect at your local (Bo1) event — e.g. seeded from the online meta and adjusted. The prediction computes each deck's expected win rate against exactly that field (same formula as the field analysis).
prediction.empty: No decks yet. "Seed from online meta" or add them manually below.
prediction.noResult: Give at least one deck a weight > 0 to compute the prediction.
prediction.rankingHint: Expected win rate against your local field (share × matchup WR, mirror = 50%). Click a deck for details.
prediction.bestPositioned: Best-positioned vs your field: {{deck}} · {{wr}}% field WR
prediction.listsHint: This deck's most successful tournament lists in the window — a build template against your local field.
prediction.listsEmpty: No published lists for this deck in the window yet.
prediction.listsSelectHint: Click a list to see how it actually fared against your field.
prediction.listWhy: This list's real games vs your local field:
prediction.noFieldGames: No recorded games vs your field for this list yet (available after the next sync).

metaTable.empty: No meta data yet. Click "Sync Live Meta" in the sidebar.
metaTable.loadError: Could not load the meta analysis.
metaTable.fieldScoreHint: Expected win rate against the current field (meta share × matchup win rate over the selected window)
metaTable.noSlugHint: Details available after the next "Sync Live Meta"

archetypeDetail.notInWindow: No tournament data for this deck in the selected window. Run "Sync Live Meta" or widen the window.

fieldScore.title: Field performance
fieldScore.explanation: Expected win rate against the current tournament field: each opponent's meta share × matchup win rate, the mirror counts as 50 %. Higher = better positioned against the field.
fieldScore.lowCoverage: Low data coverage — interpret the score with care.
fieldScore.matchupSource: Matchup data: TrainerHill · as of {{date}} · mixed Bo1/Bo3 format, treat as approximate
fieldScore.noMatchups: No matchup data imported — the score rests on the mirror only.

threats.title: What you must be prepared for
threats.subtitle: Opponents weighted by frequency × matchup weakness — common AND bad for you counts double.
threats.empty: No reliable negative matchups found in the field.
threats.freeWinsEmpty: No reliable positive matchups found in the field.

matchupTable.title: Matchups vs the field
matchupTable.subtitle: Real head-to-head win rate of this archetype against every deck in the field — favorable on top, unfavorable at the bottom.

lists.title: Most successful decklists
lists.empty: No published decklists in this window. After the next "Sync Live Meta" the tournament lists appear here.
